subject: xlim_tree changes the order of the panel.

messages.author: fa73aa45e4484463
messages.subject: xlim_tree changes the order of the panel.
parts:
Hi,
Pretty silly problem. When switching on xlim_tree, the tree is plotted on the right panel instead of the left.switching if of, and the tree is back left...

```
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtree)
# generate random tree
tr <- rtree(30)

d1 <- data.frame(id=tr$tip.label, val=rnorm(30, sd=3))

p <- ggtree(tr) +
  geom_tiplab( align=TRUE, linesize=.5) +
  xlim_tree(20) +
  theme_tree2()

p2 <- facet_plot(p, panel="dot", data=d1, geom=geom_point, aes(x=val)) 

p2
```
